purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official Ministry of Lands e-Ardhi deployment exposes a public taspro GeoServer WFS. Capabilities and the spatial_units schema were retrieved anonymously, establishing a first-party cadastral/spatial-unit map service. Bounded anonymous GetFeature requests at and around the exact WUP point timed out, so no parcel geometry or safe ID sample was verified.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Ministry map service and its spatial_units layer. Morogoro Municipal Council and Ministry pages separately evidence local land surveying/title activity, but do not establish citywide public parcel coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official e-Ardhi service page; applications require an account.
Official WFS capabilities retrieved; includes spatial_units and related land/map layers.
Official schema retrieved; safe fields id, uid and geom were identified.
Official Morogoro Municipal Council site reviewed for local custodian context; no public parcel feature service verified there.
Official Ministry page describes land services for Morogoro residents; general service context, not geometry coverage.
